items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Claude will tell you, because he had Buster Smith to join his band... so that's when Freddie Green joined the band... we were still at the Roseland Ballroom.

ctx.x: - and $100 a week and Claude will tell you, because he had Buster Smith to join his band and he had to send Buster back at $100 a week. But we wasn't leaving Kansas City without Walter Page. We'd stay there till we rot. What will we do; we're poor little lambs lost?
He was definitely their leader, right, a leader of men and -
